title: Review logistics organization boundaries
goal: Verify active schema, RLS, authoritative logistics tables, organization isolation, and overview query requirements without promoting archived migrations.

in: Active Supabase migrations for logistics, travel, lodging, rentals, communications, maps, and acknowledgements
Organization ownership derivation through events_v2, tours, and parent records
Overview aggregate query shape and fixed query-count review
out: Promoting archived travel org-key or vendor migrations
Adding schema solely to support the new overview

acceptance_criteria: Authoritative active tables and ownership paths are documented in implementation code and task evidence
No archived migration is promoted implicitly
Travel, lodging, and rental access is constrained through canonical event or tour parents
Overview reads remain batched and do not grow one query per tour or event

evidence.detail: logistics_tasks is live in the chain; `completed` is not one of its columns; `status` is.
Original aborts as a replay role; guarded form completes with 44 warnings; the owner-applied 44-policy set is identical to the original; idempotent over three applies.

verification.resultReason: Wave 35 evidence is EXECUTED for everything it claims and LOCAL: every harness runs on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster created and destroyed by the run, and every statement about authorization is a role-switched behavioural measurement rather than a policy inspection. NOT done and NOT claimed: no migration was applied to staging or production, no `supabase db reset` and no chain replay were run (CP-051), `npm run typecheck` was not run (this host has 8 GB and the full typecheck OOMs; CI measured 68m18s on 16 GB), `npm run generate:database-types` and `npm run check:database-types` were not run, and no hosted read was performed other than a read-only `supabase gen types --linked`. The hosted apply, the hosted postflight and the Supabase security-advisor rerun remain the operator gate.

marketplaceCheckoutReconciliation.headline: The P0 marketplace checkout path is reconciled INTO the active chain by three additive forward-only migrations, each with a planned manifest, a zero-drift contract postflight and executed local evidence. Nothing was applied: CP-051 keeps the apply with the operator.
marketplaceCheckoutReconciliation.consumedHandoff: HF-DB-009-MARKETPLACE-TYPE-AND-RPC-SURFACE moved to completed/ as consumed, with a disposition array.

migrations.what: Creates public.marketplace_checkout_attempts (10 columns, unique idempotency_key, ENABLE + FORCE RLS, buyer-scoped SELECT only) and adds the six P6 guest-checkout columns to public.marketplace_orders with three partial indexes.

Adds marketplace_listings.listing_kind/service_mode/public_slug/optimistic_version, widens the status CHECK to a strict superset (NOT VALID then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT), and creates marketplace_external_listings and marketplace_external_clicks with forced RLS plus a column-limited public projection.

Adds public.record_marketplace_entitlement_download(uuid,text,timestamptz): SECURITY DEFINER, search_path pinned to public, EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and anon. Replaces the service-role compare-and-swap at app/api/marketplace/delivery/[orderItemId]/route.ts:89-120.

contractTests: supabase/tests/db011_marketplace_checkout_surface_contract.sql (15 columns with type and nullability, unique coverage of idempotency_key, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, policy-command and role check, anon has no SELECT on marketplace_orders)

supabase/tests/db011_marketplace_external_listing_contract.sql (24 columns, FK to marketplace_listings, listing_id uniqueness, anon has no SELECT on the base table, the projection exists and excludes canonical_url, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, status CHECK still contains the original three values)

supabase/tests/db011_marketplace_entitlement_rpc_contract.sql (one three-arg overload, SECURITY DEFINER with search_path pinned, PUBLIC and anon denied EXECUTE, authenticated granted, the single guarded UPDATE is present, the body reads auth.uid())

departureFromArchive.why: The archived 20260728000011 has no guest_email, but app/api/marketplace/checkout/route.ts:467 writes it in the same upsert that claims the idempotency_key. Reproducing the archive verbatim would have produced a table that still fails checkout, one step later than the failure the marketplace lane proved.
departureFromArchive.rule: Caller-driven, not invented. No column was added that neither the archive nor a caller names.

deliberateNarrowing.where: the archived public-read policy on marketplace_external_listings
deliberateNarrowing.why: 20260728000003 created a table-level public SELECT policy and a comment claiming canonical_url was excluded from it. A USING predicate cannot exclude a column, so that policy would have exposed the destination URL to any anonymous caller satisfying the row predicate. Replaced by marketplace_external_listings_public (listing_id, provider_name, provider_domain, safety_status) with the base table revoked from anon.
deliberateNarrowing.needs: A named security-data reviewer sign-off, because this file does not reproduce its source verbatim.

executedEvidence.environment: throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 (Homebrew) cluster in a temp dir, socket only; the REAL chain migration 20260410120000_marketplace_core.sql applied verbatim after a minimal auth/roles bootstrap
executedEvidence.result: 33 PASS, 0 FAIL, exit 0. Each migration applied twice for idempotence with zero errors. Includes the real authorization behaviours (anon cannot EXECUTE the RPC, an anonymous call raises 42501, a signed-in non-buyer is refused, the quota sequence is 1 then 2 then refused at max_downloads=2, and two genuinely concurrent sessions at the last remaining credit produce at least one refusal) and 5 negative controls plus a post-state re-assertion.
executedEvidence.honestlyNot: NOT Supabase, NOT a hosted project, NOT a chain replay, and no supabase db reset (CP-051). The marketplace_entitlements music-commerce columns are stubbed because 20260410183000 depends on public.posts and public.artist_music; the harness ASSERTS the stubbed set against the replay attribution to 20260410183000, so chain drift breaks the harness rather than silently changing what it proves. No hosted apply, no advisor rerun and no real-data test is claimed.

gapLargerThanTheHandoff.measured: 61 marketplace surface items from the 17 archived local_only_unapplied migrations are absent from the active chain AND have at least one product-code consumer. Only the checkout and external-listing subsets are closed here.
gapLargerThanTheHandoff.alsoMissing: roughly 45 columns on marketplace_listings / marketplace_listing_variants / marketplace_integrations (integration_id, fulfillment_provider, fulfillment_profile, external_product_id, external_variant_id, source_provider, sync_status, last_external_synced_at, token_envelope, refresh_token_envelope, provider_scopes and others).
gapLargerThanTheHandoff.instrument: supabase/tests/db011_marketplace_local_only_disposition.mjs (table-scoped column matching; the first revision matched a bare column name anywhere in the chain and reported 0 gaps, which was wrong in the safe direction)

decisionsRoutedNotGuessed: max_downloads = 0: app/api/marketplace/delivery/[orderItemId]/route.ts applies .lt(download_count, max_downloads) only when max_downloads > 0, i.e. it treats 0 as unlimited. The new function enforces download_count < max_downloads unconditionally. No migration or seed writes 0, so the repository cannot settle it. The marketplace lane must answer before switching the route over.
Client: the route must call the function with the AUTHENTICATED client. A service-role JWT carries no sub claim, so auth.uid() is null inside the function and every call raises 42501.

blockers: No hosted apply, no hosted postflight, no security-advisor result, and no `supabase db reset` or chain replay (CP-051).
Stage 2 of the like tightening cannot land before the social and admin consumer switches; shipping it first produces a plausible-looking empty liker list rather than an error.
The 36 external-fulfilment items need a product decision and, for the token envelope, a security review.
The disposition instrument is a LOWER BOUND for column consumers: a file that builds its column list dynamically is not counted, so money-path items were verified by hand.
